title: C509 (native Type-2) DTLS handshake over TSCH on EMULATED nRF52840-DK (latency vs x509 anchor)

test.description: Direct C509 analogue of emul-dtls-x509-tsch.json (row 5). Server (node 1) = RPL root + TSCH coordinator; client (node 2) associates and does a native C509 Type-2 DTLS handshake over TSCH. UDGM LOSSLESS. Same DTLS cert-mode handshake as the x509 test, differing ONLY in certificate encoding (compact C509 vs X.509 DER) -> fewer 6LoWPAN fragments in the server Certificate flight -> lower handshake latency under the duty-cycled Orchestra schedule. Compare the client's 'connects' -> 'PASSED' timestamps against the x509 ~4.2 s anchor. PASSES if the client prints its handshake-1 PASSED line.

validators.pattern: Native C509 Type-2 DTLS test (handshake 1, full) PASSED
